question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Extol
solution:
The correct answer is: **Praise**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Extol **means to **praise **or glorify. (प्रशंसा या महिमा करना)
 
• It is a verb that is often used to express admiration or high regard for someone or something.
 
• Synonyms for "extol" include "praise," "commend," "laud," and "applaud."
 
 
• **Example**: *The coach would often extol the hard work and dedication of his players.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reward **means to give something to someone in recognition of their good work or behaviour. (पुरस्कार)
 
• **Punish **means to impose a penalty or consequence for wrongdoing or misbehaviour. (सज़ा देना)
 
• **Dismay **means to cause someone to feel distress or disappointment. (बेचैनी)
